Using variables of different types - creating 8 appropriate variables depending on the attributes

```{r}
cell_id_1 <- "CX1"
cell_id_2 <- "CX2"
treated_1 <- TRUE 
treated_2 <- FALSE 
n_before_1 <- 5415
n_before_2 <- 8123
n_after_1 <- 1432
n_after_2 <- 7543

# t combine
cell_id <- c(cell_id_1, cell_id_2)
treated <- c(treated_1, treated_2)
n_before <- c(n_before_1, n_before_2)
n_after <- c(n_after_1, n_after_2)

# making table 
?
my_data_frame <- tibble( 
  cell_ID = cell_id,
  treated = treated,
  num_cells_before = n_before,
  num_cells_after = n_after
)

gt(my_data_frame)
```

Making a data frame

```{r}
my_data_frame <- tibble( 
  cell_ID = cell_id,

  num_cells_after = n_after
)
  
  gt(my_data_frame)
```
